rule_title: RHEL 9 must mount /dev/shm with the noexec option.
check_text:
Verify "/dev/shm" is mounted with the "noexec" option with the following command:

$ findmnt /dev/shm

/dev/shm tmpfs  tmpfs  rw,nodev,nosuid,noexec,seclabel

If the mount options for /dev/shm does not include noexec, this is a finding.
